name: Galgar's Cactus Apple Surprise

choiceRewards.name: Mining for Dummies
tooltip: Use: Increases your Mining skill by 2. Cannot raise Mining skill over 15. You will learn Mining if it is not already trained and you do not already know two other professions.
"Explains how to mine using only the ten hundred most common words."

choiceRewards.name: Wild Harvest
tooltip: Use: Increases your Herbalism skill by 2. Cannot raise Herbalism skill over 15. You will learn Herbalism if it is not already trained and you do not already know two other professions.
"An instruction manual for picking wild herbs."

choiceRewards.name: Pelt Collecting for Beginners
tooltip: Use: Increases your Skinning skill by 2. Cannot raise Skinning skill over 15. You will learn Skinning if it is not already trained and you do not already know two other professions.
"A picture book documenting how to collect animal skins."

narrative.details:
It sure gets hot out here in the Valley of Trials.

<Galgar wipes his brow.>

If only I had some cactus apples, I could make my famous cactus apple surprise! Nothing cools you off faster than a piece of that delicious treat.

I'll tell you what, adventurer. If you bring me 10 cactus apples, I'll make you a few portions of cactus apple surprise to take with you on your adventures, and a free training manual, too. If you're interested, you can find cactus apples growing near the cactus plants around here.
narrative.objectives: Bring Galgar 10 Cactus Apples. You remember him saying that they could be found near cactuses.
narrative.offerRewardText: Wonderful, adventurer! As promised, here is your cactus apple surprise plus a little something extra.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you finished collecting cactus apples?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 1 to 3, 630 XP in all.

quests.name: The New Horde
quests.objectiveText: Report to Gornek in the Den.

quests.name: Your Place in the World
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Gornek. You recall Kaltunk marking your map with his location and mentioning that Gornek resided in the Den, a building to the west.

quests.name: Cutting Teeth
quests.objectiveText: Kill 10 Mottled Boars then return to Gornek at the Den.
